name: Shadowline
summary:
Shadowline is a tactical shooter inspired by Wildlands and Gray Zone Warfare. As an Army Ranger, you are deployed into a hostile Vietnam warzone where a local military force has seized control. Your mission: gather critical intelligence, secure vital resources, and navigate the dangers of a volatile battlefield where every decision counts. Engage in strategic combat, adapt to evolving threats, and immerse yourself in a high-stakes operation where survival and success depend on your tactics.
